brief: The smallest build that holds one bin.

requirements.evidence: One base piece with one full-depth bin (2 parts). check_build reports meshClash clear.
I left out capOpenFaces and lockJoints on purpose, to keep the part count as low as possible. The 6 open faces are uncapped.

finish.summary: I used one hex base with one full-depth bin in it, which is 2 parts and about 404 g of filament. I added no caps, no joint bolts and no props.
